mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.password, u.full_name, u.phone_number, u.is_active, u.created_at, u.updated_at, GROUP_CONCAT(r.role ORDER BY r.role SEPARATOR ',') AS role FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles r ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE u.id = ? GROUP BY u.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password, full_name, phone_number, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, TRUE, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET full_name = ?, phone_number = ?, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?
